name: @bevren/nexus
description: Terminal coding agent with persistent tools, skills, MCP, and kernels
author: duxx

scripts.test: node index.js --self-test-append && node index.js --self-test-format && node index.js --self-test-execute && node index.js --self-test-background && node index.js --self-test-remote && python tools.py --self-test-subagents && node --check index.js
scripts.build: esbuild index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/bundle.js && node --experimental-sea-config sea-config.json && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync(process.execPath,'nexus.exe')" && postject nexus.exe NODE_SEA_BLOB sea-prep.blob --sentinel-fuse NODE_SEA_FUSE_fce680ab2cc467b6e072b8b5df1996b2 && python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --distpath dist tools_launcher.spec && python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --distpath dist tools_worker.spec && copy /Y dist\tools.exe tools.exe && copy /Y dist\tools-worker.exe tools-worker.exe
